exposure: Method of cervical ripening (combined Foley's catheter and misoprostol, misoprostol only)
cohort: The study included all pregnant women who underwent induction of labor at the Maternity unit of Obio Cottage Hospital (OCH), Port-Harcourt, between January 1, 2023, and December 31, 2023.
finding: Induction of labor (IOL) is safe with a high successful vaginal delivery rate and good maternal and perinatal outcomes, especially when appropriate cervical ripening methods are used and with a birth weight in the range of 2.5-3.9kg.
mod_finding: A high successful vaginal delivery rate (87.5%) was achieved, and estimated fetal weight of 2.5-3.9kg, cervical ripening with combined Foley's catheter and misoprostol or misoprostol only, and birth weight of 2.5-3.9kg were identified as determinants of vaginal delivery.
